title: Authenticated AtlasOps product
context: Add AtlasOps identity, organization ownership, operator/lead/stakeholder roles, protected routes/storage, and a tested authorization matrix while handling a mid-sprint cross-site sharing request.

stories.title: Implement authentication and onboarding
stories.outcome: A user can sign in, establish the required profile/ownership state, and recover from incomplete onboarding.
stories.context: Treat authentication as identity only; resource authorization is delivered separately.
acceptanceCriteria: Signed-out, signed-in incomplete, active, and disabled states have defined behavior
Protected server actions derive user identity from trusted session
Redirects preserve a safe intended destination
Errors do not reveal whether another person's account exists
stories.dataContract: Profile and optional organization/membership model from approved migration.

expectations.security: No client-supplied user ID or role is trusted.
expectations.accessibility: Form errors and focus behavior work.

stories.title: Enforce role and ownership boundaries
stories.outcome: Every resource action checks actor, action, resource, and tenant/owner relationship.
stories.context: Add the minimum roles needed by the idea and enforce them in database/server boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Access matrix covers anonymous, user A, user B, privileged role, revoked membership, and missing resource
Direct URL, server action, database query, and UI behavior agree
Role changes require a privileged verified actor
Unauthorized responses avoid leaking sensitive resource details
stories.dataContract: Access matrix and RLS/server authorization rules.

expectations.security: Authorization is not a hidden button.
expectations.privacy: Tenant boundaries tested with synthetic data.
expectations.accessibility: Authorized alternatives and errors are understandable.

stories.title: Add private storage when justified
stories.outcome: Files required by the primary workflow are accessible only through checked, short-lived access.
stories.context: Skip this story if the approved idea has no genuine file requirement; document the decision instead.
acceptanceCriteria: Bucket is private and object path cannot be chosen to overwrite another user's file
Type and size are validated at trusted boundary
Signed access is short lived and issued only after authorization
Deletion/replacement behavior and orphan cleanup are documented
stories.dataContract: Object metadata links to an authorized parent record.

expectations.security: No public bucket or permanent URL.
expectations.privacy: Use safe synthetic files in tests.

stories.title: Assess cross-user sharing request
stories.outcome: A sharing request receives a safe scoped recommendation without weakening ownership boundaries.
stories.context: The stakeholder asks to let any user send a share link to another person. Analyze identity, invitation expiry, revocation, resource scope, audit, UI, notification, abuse, and support.
acceptanceCriteria: Current authorization model impact is explained
At least two implementation approaches and a defer option are compared
Recommendation identifies schema, RLS, UX, test, abuse, estimate, and rollout impact

expectations.security: Do not propose unguessable URL as sole control.
expectations.privacy: Recipient and shared data scope minimized.
expectations.analytics: Share accepted/revoked events only if approved.

stories.title: Close cross-tenant storage exposure
stories.outcome: A user cannot obtain another tenant's file through a guessed path or copied URL.
stories.context: Marcus provides a synthetic reproduction where the metadata page is protected but the object can still be downloaded.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposure is reproduced safely before the change
Authorization occurs before signed-link creation and storage policy matches parent ownership
Copied/expired links and revoked membership cases are tested
stories.dataContract: Storage path maps to authorized database record.

expectations.security: Fix the boundary, not the visible link.

nonGoals: Making object names harder to guess
stories.seededBug: Issue signed URLs from a server route that checks only whether the caller is signed in, not ownership of the parent record.
